text:
kelly: FYI Acme reported a spike in errors after we routed traffic to eu-west failover. They see a tokenizer/decoding error and degraded outputs. request_id=req_98765, customer says latency also doubled.

ryan: Can you paste the exact API request/response and the region header they're sending? Any correlation IDs from our side?

kelly: Pasting the sample from their ticket. Note: they set X-Region: eu-west-1 and requested model rw-7b-v1-fp16 but the response shows a different served variant.
```http
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer sk_XXXX
X-Region: eu-west-1
{
  "model": "rw-7b-v1-fp16",
  "input": "Summarize the following..."
}
```
Response (500):
```json
{
  "error": "tokenizer config missing for model variant",
  "served_variant": "rw-7b-v1-q4",
  "request_id": "req_98765"
}
```
Also seeing p95 latency ~1.2s for these calls.

deploy-bot: [2026-08-18T11:20:15Z] Failover triggered (policy=capacity): primary us-east-1 -> eu-west-1. Routed to compatible variant table: rw-7b-v1 -> rw-7b-v1-q4 (fallback).

marco: That mapping is wrong for this model -- the q4 variant was never onboarded with the tokenizer files (onboarding bug). The fallback table should have preferred rw-7b-v2-compat or the FP16 variant. Looks like cross-region fallback chose the smallest compatible variant heuristically.

lenora: Confirmed in onboarding logs: quantized artifact for rw-7b-v1-q4 missing tokenizer manifest entry (vocab.json path absent). When runtime tries to load tokenizer it errors out. I can reproduce locally by trying to instantiate tokenizer for rw-7b-v1-q4; stack trace points to missing vocab.bin.

ryan: Can you share repro steps so I can hit it from infra side and tail the node logs? I'll need a curl with headers and the request id. Also which project/account is affected so we can add a routing override.

kelly: Repro curl we told Acme to run (also used by us):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_XXXX' \
  -H 'X-Region: eu-west-1' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-7b-v1-fp16","input":"test tokenizer"}'
```
Response includes request_id=req_98765.

marco: Short-term fix: add routing override for project:acme to force model -> rw-7b-v1-fp16 (no variant fallback) and disable automatic variant fallback for cross-region until we fix artifacts. I'll push a control-plane patch to apply override.

lenora: Long-term fix: update onboarding pipeline to ensure tokenizer files are bundled into quantized artifacts, add a CI check that validates tokenizer.load() for each artifact. Created INF-3241 to track. Also adding a runtime guard to refuse to route to a variant if tokenizer manifest absent.

ryan: Also flagging potential billing mapping issue: if fallback served a different SKU (q4) billing usage might be recorded differently for the customer. Finance/watchdog should double-check usage for project:acme during the incident window.

kelly: Created support ticket CIT-2026-774 for Acme, notified them of routing override. I'll update with timeframe — routing override until we confirm onboarding fix.

ryan: ACK. I'll monitor traces and error rates for req_98765 and similar. Will post back in an hour with metrics. :eyes:

deploy-bot: [2026-08-18T11:27:00Z] Control-plane: routing override applied for project:acme -> model:rw-7b-v1-fp16 (auto-revert=2026-08-18T12:00:00Z).
